init.title: EMS-ESP dashboard
init.description:
Choose who sees the “EMS-ESP” dashboard and the Bosch HMI 800 panel in the sidebar.

**Access from outside (wall tablet, Safari, kiosk):** the panel needs a long-lived access token from Home Assistant. The integration cannot create this token itself – it is your authorisation for the access.
1. Create the token in Home Assistant: Profile (bottom left) → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. Paste the long text (starts with “eyJ…”), not its name.
2. Paste the token below and **Submit**.
3. Open **Configure** again and copy the **kiosk address**.

data.In Sidebar Admin anzeigen: Show in sidebar for admins only
data.Bosch HMI 800: Token für Zugriff von auß: Bosch HMI 800: long-lived access token from HA (for access from outside)
data.Bosch HMI 800: neuen Kiosk-Schlüssel erz: Bosch HMI 800: create new kiosk key (old address stops working)

data_description.In Sidebar Benutzer anzeigen: Off: no sidebar entry. The dashboard stays reachable for administrators at /ems-esp.
data_description.In Sidebar Admin anzeigen: On: only administrators see the dashboard; other users neither see nor can open it.
data_description.Bosch HMI 800: Token für Zugriff von auß: Paste only the token from HA → Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens. The kiosk key is not a token. Checked on save.
data_description.Bosch HMI 800: Kiosk-Adresse (nur zum Ko: Open this address on the tablet. It always uses the token above – a token in the panel settings is not used.
data_description.Bosch HMI 800: neuen Kiosk-Schlüssel erz: Only creates a new key for the kiosk address (e.g. if a device was lost). Does not create a token.

samsung.title: Samsung EHS panel
samsung.description:
Choose who sees the Samsung EHS panel in the sidebar.

**Access from outside (wall tablet, kiosk):** create a long-lived access token in Home Assistant (Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens), paste it below and submit. Then open **Configure** again and copy the **kiosk address**.

error.panel_token_invalid: Home Assistant does not know this token. Create a new one under Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens and paste the full text (starts with “eyJ…”).
error.panel_token_not_long_lived: This is not a long-lived token (it expires soon). Create one under Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens.
